title: Decathlon launches Wero payment option on decathlon.de
excerpt: Decathlon adds the European bank-backed Wero payment option to decathlon.de, with in-store rollout in preparation
content_html:
Decathlon didn’t just add a new payment button to its German checkout page. It handed European banks their first big-box sporting goods test case at a moment when competition in digital payments is intensifying and the push for EU-made payment infrastructure is growing.

Decathlon switched on Wero on decathlon.de on July 20, making Germany the first market in the French group’s international footprint to carry the European payment scheme.

Wero is the retail payment product of the European Payments Initiative (EPI), a consortium of banks and payment providers backed by 18 shareholder institutions and more than 50 members across the region. It routes payments directly between bank accounts in real time, authorized in the customer’s banking app via fingerprint or face recognition, so the merchant never receives a card number.

Archive reporting shows the scale Wero is still building toward: 43 million active users across the region in August 2025, 46 million by November 2025 alongside the retail launch, and around 56 million by the time of the Decathlon rollout in July 2026, with German registrations rising from 1.3 million to 1.8 million over the same period.

Decathlon joins a merchant roster that already includes Eventim Live, with Lidl, Rossmann and Hornbach expected to follow.

The insider why

For Decathlon, the incentive is not just optics. Patrick Müller, chief digital and chief marketing officer at Decathlon Germany, tied the launch to the retailer’s membership program, saying the connection delivers “a genuine added value” on every purchase. That frames Wero as a loyalty and retention tool, not only a checkout option. Industry estimates commonly place card network processing costs at around 1 to 2 percent of transaction value in fees to Visa and Mastercard. An account to account rail that bypasses that layer can be a direct margin lever for a retailer operating at scale on thin sporting goods margins.

The rollout plan extends beyond the website.

Decathlon says it is preparing the technical integration needed to bring Wero to its roughly 110 physical stores in Germany, with the goal of a consistent payment experience across online and offline channels. A joint activation campaign with EPI is scheduled for October: a six week promotion offering a €10 voucher to customers who pay with Wero on decathlon.de, funded entirely by EPI rather than Decathlon.

The challenge and the promise

EPI’s willingness to fund customer incentives points to the network’s core problem. Payment schemes live or die on how many merchants and consumers show up at the same time, and Wero still lacks in store point of sale functionality. That capability is not expected until 2026 and 2027. Joachim Schmalzl, EPI’s supervisory board chairman, has acknowledged the initiative still faces real hurdles even as he called the ecommerce launch a milestone toward “a sovereign European payment system.”

Decathlon being among the first to implement the system can help test Wero’s promise: lower processing costs, tighter loyalty integration and one less transaction fee flowing to a US based network, provided Wero can close the gap between its ambitions and its still limited in store reach.

content_html_zh:
迪卡侬不仅仅在其德国结账页面添加了一个新的支付按钮。 在数字支付竞争日益激烈、对欧盟制造的支付基础设施的推动力不断增强之际，它向欧洲银行提供了第一个大型体育用品测试案例。

迪卡侬于 7 月 20 日在 decathlon.de 上启用 Wero，使德国成为这家法国集团国际业务中第一个支持欧洲支付方案的市场。

Wero 是欧洲支付倡议 (EPI) 的零售支付产品，EPI 是一个由银行和支付提供商组成的联盟，由该地区 18 家股东机构和 50 多个成员支持。 它可以实时在银行账户之间直接进行支付，并通过指纹或面部识别在客户的银行应用程序中进行授权，因此商家永远不会收到卡号。

档案报告显示，Wero 的规模仍在不断扩大：到 2025 年 8 月，该地区的活跃用户数量将达到 4300 万；到 2025 年 11 月零售发布时，活跃用户数量将达到 4600 万；到 2026 年 7 月迪卡侬推出时，活跃用户数量将达到约 5600 万，同期德国注册用户数量从 130 万增至 180 万。

迪卡侬加入了已经包括 Eventim Live 在内的商家名单，Lidl、Rossmann 和 Hornbach 预计也会紧随其后。

知情人透露原因

对于迪卡侬来说，激励因素不仅仅是光学。 德国迪卡侬首席数字兼首席营销官帕特里克·穆勒 (Patrick Müller) 将此次发布与该零售商的会员计划联系在一起，称这种联系为每次购买带来“真正的附加值”。 这将 Wero 视为一种忠诚度和保留工具，而不仅仅是一种结账选项。 业界估计，Visa 和 Mastercard 的卡网络处理成本通常约为交易价值的 1% 至 2%。 对于体育用品利润微薄的大规模经营零售商来说，绕过该层的账户到账户铁路可以成为直接的利润杠杆。

推出计划超出了网站范围。

迪卡侬表示，正在准备将 Wero 引入其在德国约 110 家实体店所需的技术整合，目标是在线上和线下渠道上提供一致的支付体验。 与 EPI 计划于 10 月开展联合激活活动：为期六周的促销活动，向在 decathlon.de 上使用 Wero 付款的客户提供 10 欧元代金券，该代金券完全由 EPI 而不是迪卡侬资助。

挑战与承诺

EPI 愿意为客户激励措施提供资金，这表明了该网络的核心问题。 支付方案的存亡取决于有多少商家和消费者同时出现，而 Wero 仍然缺乏商店销售点功能。 预计要到 2026 年和 2027 年才会具备这种能力。 EPI 监事会主席约阿希姆·施马尔茨尔 (Joachim Schmalzl) 承认，该计划仍面临真正的障碍，尽管他称电子商务的推出是迈向“欧洲主权支付系统”的里程碑。

迪卡侬是首批实施该系统的公司之一，可以帮助测试 Wero 的承诺：降低处理成本、更紧密的忠诚度整合以及流向美国网络的交易费用减少，前提是 Wero 能够缩小其雄心壮志与其仍然有限的商店覆盖范围之间的差距。
